tagline_en: Moisture-locking barrier repair with a light, refined feel

overview_zh: 添加麦角硫因和肌肤保湿成分，珍贵成分修护肌肤脂质，保护与修复皮肤细胞；多肽及多种植物精华深入滋润肌肤，缓解肌肤干燥，扫除肌肤黄气，令肌肤水润弹滑。
benefits_en: Relieves dryness while replenishing and locking in moisture and nutrition
benefits_zh: 缓解皮肤干燥，补水锁水锁营养
claims_flagged: Overview claims protection and repair of skin cells against DNA damage from infrared light — strong efficacy claim, verify before publishing.
